found_at: https://pdfless.com/favicons/site.webmanifest (the web app manifest linked from pdfless.com)
notes: DECISION: Pdfless has no symbol; its favicon and app icons are the PDFLESS wordmark on a navy tile, so this is its own icon mark (rule 1's wordmark-only case). The navy tile is that icon's own tile. No SVG qualified: the n8n node's SVGs wrap a base64 PNG. The manifest names /android-chrome-512x512.png at the root; the file is served from /favicons/.
license: Pdfless brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Pdfless.
